name: Beehiiv
summary: Newsletter platform with growth, automation, SEO and monetisation tooling, priced by subscriber count. You keep 100% of paid subscriptions where Substack takes 10%; the trade is a steeper start than Substack's near-zero setup and built-in discovery.
best_for: newsletter operators who want growth tools, automation, SEO control and ad/referral monetisation — and to keep 100% of subscription revenue
skip_if: you're a beginner starting from zero who wants the simplest setup and Substack's built-in discovery, and don't need automation or SEO
honest_knock: Next to Substack it's more to learn. Substack's built-in discovery network and dead-simple setup are easier if you're starting from zero with no audience and don't care about automation or SEO. Beehiiv's depth is the point, but it's a steeper start.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-05 on beehiiv.com/pricing, prices in USD) Subscriber-based, and you keep 100% of paid subscriptions — beehiiv shows a 0% take rate, against Substack's 10%, leaving only Stripe's 2.9% + $0.30. Free is $0 up to 2,500 subscribers with unlimited sends. At up to 1,000 subscribers Lite is $59/mo billed monthly or $49/mo on yearly billing, Pro $109/mo or $95/mo yearly. At 10,000 subscribers Lite is $139/mo ($119 yearly) and Pro $239/mo ($199 yearly); at 50,000 Lite is $299/mo ($249) and Pro $469/mo ($399); at 100,000 Lite is $469/mo ($399) and Pro $699/mo ($599). Lite stops at 100,000 subscribers; Pro runs on to $999/mo billed monthly at 250,000+.
